text: No, the 2023 loss was not a eucalyptus harvest—it was a small, isolated tree-cover loss event (0.7 ha, 1.2% of the asset) that likely reflects clearing rather than commercial harvest. The event was detected in Hansen GFC data but was excluded from analysis because it fell below the 0.5-ha minimum event area threshold. Additionally, the loss occurred within a planted forest area (0.4 ha of *Eucalyptus grandis*), but the small size and fragmented nature (0.4 ha in patches under 0.5 ha) suggest localized clearing rather than a systematic harvest. No further losses were observed in subsequent years (2024–2025).
